### 5. Census 2017 to 2024: the comunas that lost the most people (two sources joined on the comuna code)

```sql
SELECT c24.cut, c24.comuna, c17.population AS census_2017, c24.population AS census_2024,
       cast(c24.population AS bigint) - cast(c17.population AS bigint) AS change
FROM factsync.ine_census2024 c24
JOIN factsync.ine_census2017 c17 ON c17.cut = c24.cut
ORDER BY change
LIMIT 5
```

| cut | comuna | census_2017 | census_2024 | change |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 13119 | MAIPÚ | 521627 | 503635 | -17992 |
| 05101 | VALPARAÍSO | 296655 | 284938 | -11717 |
| 13116 | LO ESPEJO | 98804 | 87295 | -11509 |
| 02103 | SIERRA GORDA | 10186 | 1472 | -8714 |
| 13105 | EL BOSQUE | 162505 | 155257 | -7248 |

_5 row(s) shown; 845 ms._

### 7. INE projections vs Census 2024: where the 2024 projection overshot the count the most

```sql
SELECT p.cut, p.comuna, p.population AS projection_2024, c.population AS census_2024,
       p.population - cast(c.population AS bigint) AS overshoot
FROM factsync.ine_projections p
JOIN factsync.ine_census2024 c ON c.cut = p.cut
WHERE p.year = 2024
ORDER BY overshoot DESC
LIMIT 5
```

| cut | comuna | projection_2024 | census_2024 | overshoot |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 13101 | Santiago | 544388 | 438856 | 105532 |
| 13201 | Puente Alto | 667904 | 568086 | 99818 |
| 13119 | Maipú | 586812 | 503635 | 83177 |
| 13125 | Quilicura | 275744 | 205624 | 70120 |
| 13114 | Las Condes | 343632 | 296134 | 47498 |

### 9. Census 2002 to 2024: the fastest-growing comunas

```sql
SELECT c.cut, c.comuna, o.population AS census_2002, c.population AS census_2024,
       round(cast(c.population AS double) / o.population, 2) AS ratio
FROM factsync.ine_census2024 c
JOIN factsync.ine_census2002 o ON o.cut = c.cut
WHERE o.population > 0
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 5
```

| cut | comuna | census_2002 | census_2024 | ratio |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 07105 | MAULE | 16837 | 61081 | 3.63 |
| 13302 | LAMPA | 40228 | 145160 | 3.61 |
| 01107 | ALTO HOSPICIO | 50215 | 142086 | 2.83 |
| 05605 | EL TABO | 7028 | 16260 | 2.31 |
| 13301 | COLINA | 77815 | 173293 | 2.23 |

_5 row(s) shown; 709 ms._
